content.rationale: Listing is where the boundary meets the log verb; the gate forces `jj log` to answer to the set read and the summary handle without re-deciding either. Its three edges span two cells — two prose parents (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
